mapper.insert: INSERT INTO menu_role_perm ( menu_no , role_no , disp_yn , view_yn , ins_yn , upd_yn , del_yn , reg_user , reg_date ) SELECT menu_no , #{roleNo} , 'N' , 'N' , 'N' , 'N' , 'N' , #{regUser} , NOW() FROM menu WHERE use_yn = 'Y'
mapper.select:
WITH RECURSIVE menu_tree AS ( SELECT m.menu_no -- 메뉴 번호(PK) , m.menu_name -- 메뉴 명 , m.menu_lev -- 메뉴 깊이 , m.sort_ord -- 같은 부모내 순서 , CAST(LPAD(m.sort_ord, 5, '0') AS CHAR(200)) AS path -- 계층 정렬용 FROM menu m WHERE (m.parent_no IS NULL OR m.parent_no = 0) AND m.use_yn = 'Y'
UNION ALL
SELECT m.menu_no , m.menu_name , m.menu_lev , m.sort_ord , CONCAT(mt.path, '/', LPAD(m.sort_ord, 5, '0')) FROM menu m INNER JOIN menu_tree mt ON m.parent_no = mt.menu_no WHERE m.use_yn = 'Y' ) SELECT mt.menu_no AS menuNo , mt.menu_name AS menuName , mt.menu_lev AS menuLev , mt.sort_ord AS sortOrd , mrp.disp_yn AS dispYn , mrp.view_yn AS viewYn , mrp.ins_yn AS insYn , mrp.upd_yn AS updYn , mrp.del_yn AS delYn FROM menu_tree mt LEFT JOIN menu_role_perm mrp ON mt.menu_no = mrp.menu_no AND mrp.role_no = #{roleNo} -- 파라미터로 받은 특정 롤의 권한만 매핑 ORDER BY mt.path -- 사이드바와 동일한 계층 순서 보장
